note: Structure from the PerformanceScript, voice and emotion from IndexTTS-2. The engine changed; the script did not, which is what engine-agnostic was for. New in 0.2: each fragment carries its own emotion vector, so the line has an arc instead of one constant setting - which is how distress actually behaves. Someone frightened tries to sound reasonable, fails, and gets quieter.

composure goes - the peak of the arc
